label: HISTORICAL BACKTEST

checks.emaWarmup: Signals begin only after 100 completed bars. First entry is 2024-04-11, after the EMA100 seed.
checks.nextBarFills: Every fill date is later than its signal bar. No same-bar close fills.
checks.sizing: 1 percent equity risk over 2x ATR14 Wilder, capped at 95 percent of cash. No leverage.
checks.costAccounting: Report feesPaid is entry plus exit. Trade-level fees field stores the exit leg only.

primaryCause: Participation and whipsaw, not a single catastrophic loss.
factors: The strategy was long about half the time and captured only 13.9 percent open-to-open versus 73.7 percent buy-and-hold. Most of the BTC appreciation occurred while it was in cash.
Thirteen of fifteen trades lost. The entire positive result depends on two long holds (136 and 121 days).
Median hold was 12 days, with several 2-day whipsaws in 2025 and 2026.
Costs were large relative to the small gross. Doubling them turned the sample negative.
